other_failure_modes.name: Random cross-validation on time-series data
other_failure_modes.description: Using random folds (e.g., KFold with shuffle=True) on data containing explicit date/time features can cause temporal leakage, where future information is used to predict the past.

summary: The agent provides a strong structural approach with out-of-fold target encoding, cross-validation, and an optimized ensemble. However, it introduces significant data leakage by calculating frequency encodings and group-by statistics on the combined train and test datasets. Furthermore, the use of a randomized K-Fold on what appears to be time-series data risks temporal leakage, leading to overly optimistic validation scores.
